caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Grab your toothbrush! Let's go!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Verse]
Rory has big teeth for a roar,
Brush them, brush them, brush some more!
Top teeth, bottom teeth, one, two, three,
Rory's roar is sparkly clean!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Verse]
Ziggy brushes after tea,
Tiny teeth as white as can be!
Swish and spit and rinse it out,
Ziggy smiles and gives a shout!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Verse]
Waffles brushes, foamy and white,
Bubbles on his nose, what a sight!
Brush the front and brush the back,
Waffles' teeth go clickety clack!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Verse]
Pebble's beak needs a little scrub,
Tickle, tickle, scrub a dub!
Up and down and all around,
Pebble's beak is shiny now!

[Bridge]
Brush the top! Brush, brush, brush!
Brush the bottom! Brush, brush, brush!
Now swish, swish, swish, and spit it out,
Show your smile and give a shout!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Chorus]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up on top and underneath!
Round and round and side to side,
Shiny teeth and a smile so wide!

[Outro]
Sparkly smiles! Bye bye, friends!
